qualification: measured on a shared, loaded host
cpuMetric: observed total host CPU percentage, retained as integer samples
compilerCountMetric: observed compiler-process counts; the rustc-only count is identified separately where known
samplingLimits: Discrete observations, not synchronized to individual frames. Observation order is retained; exact timestamps were not persisted. No CPU values are inferred for unsampled runs.

contendedRunPostObservation.relation: immediate post-run observation; not the average CPU load during the benchmark

finalMatrixStartObservation.relation: last pre-launch observation; no exclusive window or sustained-load claim

handoff: Parent requested no further quiet-window wait and will rerun all performance benchmarks on a quiet machine after integration.
